parameters.name: ClassicExpendExpiredDays
parameters.description: The retention period of the classic network endpoint of the instance. Valid values: **14**, **30**, **60**, and **120**. Unit: day.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-db-instance-net-expire-time --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --connection-string dds-bpxxxxxxxx.mongodb.rds.aliyuncs.com --classic-expend-expired-days 30 --region cn-hangzhou
